limits: Stopped through the guard after the Wazuh collector hit a ten-minute-run directory bound; both shutdown paths verified. Stopped before the database export, so processing latency is not measured here.
Counts are from retained journals; this is not a 24-hour result.

wazuh_capture.cause: The continuous collector reused the reviewed ten-minute finder, which refuses a Wazuh month log folder with more than 64 entries; Wazuh rotates archives every ten minutes, so after about 63 rotations the folder passed the bound and the collector stopped itself cleanly. The captured data stayed sealed and intact.
wazuh_capture.fix: The continuous collector now has its own 4,096-entry bound (tested with 300 rotated files); the pinned bootstrap is unchanged.
